anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: The After wording moved e1 and e3 as intended and kept e2. For e1, Before printed a plain `PRs to gate:` line, while After prints the bold `**PRs to gate:**` heading as visible reply text, with both entries linked, in typed order (#112 then #101), each with its ticket and a short change phrase. For e3, Before minted the run folder and initialized the tracker first, then ran the full Gather (CI runs, diff, comments) before showing an unbolded list. After runs only the PR view and the two viewer lookups plus the ticket display reads, shows `**PR to gate:**` before the run folder, continuation record and tracker exist, and then says Gather reuses the saved PR and viewer reads. e2 held in both: `by pat` carries no review-request wording, no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed, and the message asks for nothing. To keep these results, retain the explicit ordering for one typed PR (list metadata reads, then visible bold list, then run folder, continuation record and tracker), the statement that the list is the visible text of the reply carrying the next tool call with no marker and no wait, and the instruction that Gather reuses the initial reads instead of rerunning them. One thing to watch: in Run A After still mints the parent run folder before gathering and listing. No fact here forbids that for sets, but if you want the set path to match the single-PR ordering, the wording should say so explicitly.
